vc_checking.summary: All seven cleaned manual VCs are semantically provable under the frozen xizi_dll/xizi_dllseg predicates and case-lib dispatch definitions. Four witnesses need two proved, group-local inverse segment helpers (split at a first occurrence and reclose around a member); the remaining witnesses close directly by opening/unfolding/closing xizi_dll or by reducing the unified dispatch definition. No annotation/spec return is required.

vc_shape.pre_pure: xizi_double_link_next_anchor linklist_pre nodes_dispatch_case linklist_node_pre, i.e. In linklist_node_pre nodes_dispatch_case or linklist_node_pre=linklist_pre.
vc_shape.post_spatial: Either the sentinel links plus a complete sentinel-to-sentinel dllseg, or sentinel links, a prefix dllseg, the queried node links, and a suffix dllseg.
vc_shape.post_pure: Sentinel alternative: non-null head/first, node=head, and dispatch=first_value full nodes. Member alternative: first-occurrence decomposition, non-null/non-sentinel node, and dispatch=first_value suffix.

witnesses.witness_instantiation: Destruct the anchor. In the sentinel case use first/last from xizi_dll_open. In the member case apply xizi_double_link_in_first_occurrence__dll_dispatch_and_reclose to obtain nodes_before/nodes_after, then take the four spatial boundary pointers returned by the split helper.
witnesses.space_plan: Use xizi_dll_open for node=head. For In node nodes, use the candidate split-at-first-occurrence helper to expose sentinel links, prefix segment, selected-node links, and suffix segment without losing ownership; unfold xizi_dll_links only to match generated points-to syntax.
witnesses.pure_plan: For node=head, unfold xizi_double_link_next_anchor and xizi_double_link_next_dispatch_value and select the equal branch of Z.eq_dec. For the member case, the split helper supplies node<>head, node<>0, first<>0; combine these with the seed first-occurrence equality/nonmembership and xizi_double_link_next_value_at_first_occurrence__dll_dispatch_and_reclose.
witnesses.refinement_plan: Not a safeExec refinement; the two alternatives are a direct predicate decomposition selected by the anchor disjunction.
premise_discharge: The split helper's nodes equation and ~In premise are exactly the two conclusions of the frozen first-occurrence seed lemma.
The helper consumes only the current xizi_dll resource and returns all generated spatial pieces plus head/first/member non-null and member<>head facts.
witnesses.failure_signal: None; the required spatial resource is present and the helper premises all come from PreH1 plus the frozen xizi_dll predicate.
witnesses.grouping_reason: Introduces the same split/reclose helper family used by the member return and wrapper VCs.

vc_shape.pre_spatial: For the selected second disjunct: the sentinel node_next cell followed by xizi_dllseg first head head last nodes_dispatch_case.
vc_shape.pre_pure: first=head, head<>0, node=head, and dispatch=head-case first_value nodes_dispatch_case.
vc_shape.post_spatial: The same dllseg and sentinel node_next cell, with the generated sepcon order, under EX first_2.

witnesses.witness_instantiation: Choose the second Coq disjunct and first_2:=first.
witnesses.space_plan: Destruct nodes_dispatch_case. The nil branch preserves the incoming cell and segment; the cons branch is impossible because a nonempty xizi_dllseg requires its start to differ from its stop, while first=head.
witnesses.pure_plan: In the only possible nil branch, xizi_double_link_first_value nil=0; PreH4 fixes node=head, so unfolding dispatch selects the head branch and PreH5 yields dispatch=0. PreH2 supplies head<>0.
witnesses.refinement_plan: Not applicable; select the easier generated return alternative.
premise_discharge: dispatch reduction uses PreH4, PreH5, and the forced nodes_dispatch_case=nil shape.
witnesses.grouping_reason: Uses the same segment semantics but requires only direct empty-case unfolding.

vc_shape.pre_spatial: For the selected second disjunct: prefix dllseg to linklist_node_pre, both queried-node fields, and suffix dllseg from node_next to the sentinel.
vc_shape.pre_pure: node_next=head, full nodes=before++node::after, first occurrence, dispatch=first_value after, node/head/first non-null, and node<>head.
vc_shape.post_spatial: One reclosed xizi_dllseg from first to the sentinel over nodes_dispatch_case.

witnesses.witness_instantiation: Choose the second Coq disjunct; no right-side existential is needed.
witnesses.space_plan: Because node_next=head, the suffix segment starts at its stop, so its abstract list nodes_after must be nil. Treat the queried fields as xizi_dll_links and apply the candidate reclose-at-member helper to prefix, selected node, and empty suffix; rewrite by PreH4.
witnesses.pure_plan: Unfold the start=stop suffix after destructing nodes_after to rule out cons. With nodes_after=nil, first_value nodes_after=0, and PreH6 gives dispatch=0.
witnesses.refinement_plan: Not applicable; this is the last-member return branch.
premise_discharge: the queried-node links are exactly the two points-to resources in P.
witnesses.failure_signal: None; both helper side conditions and all spatial components are present.
witnesses.grouping_reason: Direct consumer of the shared segment reclose helper.

vc_shape.pre_spatial: For the selected second disjunct: suffix after node_next, both node_next fields, prefix before linklist_node_pre, and both queried-node fields.
vc_shape.pre_pure: nodes_after=node_next::l0, node_next<>head, full nodes=before++node::after, first occurrence, dispatch=first_value after, and non-null/non-sentinel bounds.
vc_shape.post_spatial: One reclosed xizi_dllseg from first to head over nodes_dispatch_case.

witnesses.witness_instantiation: Choose the second Coq disjunct; no existential is required.
witnesses.space_plan: Frame the node_next links into the suffix segment shape already represented by nodes_after=node_next::l0, treat the queried-node fields as xizi_dll_links, apply reclose-at-member to prefix/query/suffix, and rewrite by PreH5.
witnesses.pure_plan: Rewrite PreH1 so first_value nodes_after simplifies to node_next; combine with PreH7 to obtain node_next=dispatch.
witnesses.refinement_plan: Not applicable; this is the non-last-member return branch.
premise_discharge: the before/selected/after list equation is PreH5.
the concrete fields and suffix dllseg supply every spatial premise.
witnesses.grouping_reason: Same reclose helper as return_wit_2, differing only in the nonempty suffix pure reduction.

vc_shape.pre_spatial: For the selected first disjunct: both sentinel fields and xizi_dllseg first head head last nodes_dispatch_case.
vc_shape.pre_pure: first<>head, head<>0, first<>0, node=head, and dispatch=first_value nodes_dispatch_case.

witnesses.space_plan: Apply xizi_dllseg_unfold using first<>head to obtain nodes_dispatch_case=first::rest while retaining the expanded segment resources, then re-fold as needed and apply xizi_dll_close to sentinel links plus the complete segment.
witnesses.pure_plan: The unfolded list equation makes first_value nodes_dispatch_case simplify to first; PreH5 then gives first=dispatch. PreH2 discharges xizi_dll_close's head<>0 premise.
witnesses.refinement_plan: Not applicable; sentinel query with a nonempty list.
witnesses.grouping_reason: Uses the same open/reclose predicate family without a new helper.

vc_shape.post_spatial: An anchored dispatch precondition carrying the same xizi_dll, separated from a wand that transforms any dispatch result/resource into the sentinel-specific result/resource.
vc_shape.post_pure: anchor and equality of unified dispatch-at-head with xizi_double_link_first_value nodes_sentinel_case.
vc_shape.post_exists: nodes_dispatch_case, retval_2 supplied to the wand, and branch retval.

witnesses.witness_instantiation: Choose nodes_dispatch_case:=nodes_sentinel_case. After wand introduction and receipt of retval_2, choose retval:=retval_2 (or the branch first_value directly).
witnesses.space_plan: Put the incoming xizi_dll in the anchored dispatch precondition. The wand starts from emp and, when its antecedent supplies a fresh xizi_dll, passes that exact resource to its consequent; no duplication or loss occurs.
witnesses.pure_plan: Build the anchor's right disjunct from node=head. Unfold xizi_double_link_next_dispatch_value; the equal Z.eq_dec branch yields first_value of the unchanged sequence, so the received retval_2 equality establishes the target retval equality.
witnesses.refinement_plan: This is a direct branch-to-unified-spec wrapper: identity sequence choice, wand introduction, and equality normalization; no safeExec state.
premise_discharge: node=head is the antecedent pure fact.
the wand antecedent itself supplies the xizi_dll required by the wand consequent.
witnesses.grouping_reason: Uses the same dispatch definition and preserved xizi_dll resource as the other witnesses.

vc_shape.post_spatial: An anchored dispatch precondition carrying the same xizi_dll, separated from a wand that maps a unified dispatch result/resource to xizi_double_link_next_value on the same sequence/resource.
vc_shape.post_exists: nodes_dispatch_case, retval_2 supplied to the wand, and branch retval.

witnesses.witness_instantiation: Choose nodes_dispatch_case:=nodes_member_case. Use the seed first-occurrence lemma to choose before/after while deriving member<>head through the split helper; after wand introduction choose retval:=retval_2.
witnesses.space_plan: Split xizi_dll at the first occurrence to expose member<>head, then use the reclose helper and xizi_dll_close to restore exactly xizi_dll nodes_member_case before constructing the anchored dispatch precondition. The wand preserves the resource supplied by its own antecedent.
witnesses.pure_plan: The split helper yields node<>head from the well-formed circular segment. Unfold dispatch and select the unequal Z.eq_dec branch, giving dispatch=next_value; combine with the received retval_2 equality.
witnesses.refinement_plan: Direct member-branch wrapper; the split/reclose detour derives the necessary pure non-sentinel fact without changing the abstract sequence.
premise_discharge: In node nodes is the antecedent and feeds the frozen first-occurrence lemma.
The split helper supplies node<>0 and node<>head plus all reclose resources.
The split helper also supplies head<>0, discharging xizi_dll_close after segment reclosure.
witnesses.failure_signal: None; node<>head is derivable from xizi_dll well-formedness rather than an extra annotation premise.
witnesses.grouping_reason: Reuses both inverse segment helpers and the frozen first-occurrence semantics.

analysis_groups.shared_proof_pattern: Open/split/reclose the same circular DLL predicate at sentinel or queried-member boundaries, then normalize the unified dispatch result with the frozen list-level definitions.
analysis_groups.shared_space_plan: Use xizi_dll_open/close and two inverse group-local segment helpers; direct start=stop or start<>stop unfolding handles the small return cases.
analysis_groups.shared_pure_plan: Use anchor cases, first-occurrence equations/nonmembership, segment-derived member<>head, and first_value simplification; no extra premise is invented.
analysis_groups.shared_refinement_plan: The derive witnesses use identity sequence choice plus wand introduction; the other witnesses are direct entailments over the same predicate resources.
analysis_groups.grouping_reason: One worker can prove both inverse helpers once and reuse them across all seven related obligations; 7 is within the controller limit 12 and avoids duplicating group-suffixed helpers.

proof_groups.proof_strategy: Prove the inverse dllseg split/reclose helpers in the group-local case_lib, then solve the seven witnesses in manual order using xizi_dll open/close, direct segment unfolding for empty/nonempty suffix facts, the frozen first-occurrence lemmas, and direct dispatch-definition reduction.
proof_groups.natural_language_proof_pattern: Predicate-first DLL split/reclose plus list-level dispatch normalization.
proof_groups.grouping_reason: All seven share one helper family; one group avoids duplicate suffixed helpers and remains within the limit 12.
